news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: ₹4.16 loss per share (improved from ₹5.48 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹24.6b (down 46% from FY 2025). Net loss: ₹18.3b (loss narrowed 20% from FY 2025). news.title: Ola Electric Mobility Reportedly Seeks to Sell Stake in Ola Cell Technologies Private Ltd
news.body: Ola Electric Mobility Limited (NSEI:OLAELEC) is stepping up efforts to raise cash, including a proposed INR 20,000 million stake sale in its battery arm, Ola Cell Technologies Private Limited, after its board earlier approved a INR 15,000 million fundraise through share or securities issuance. The latest move, to sell a stake in Ola Cell Technologies, is aimed at unlocking capital from a key business. Execution remains uncertain. The company's previously announced fundraising plans are yet to be closed, and its share price performance has lagged the broader auto index. This backdrop suggests limited investor appetite, even as the company seeks to raise capital through multiple routes, including a potential stake sale in its battery unit. news.title: Ola Electric Mobility Limited Announces CFO Changes
news.body: Electric two-wheeler manufacturer Ola Electric announced a senior leadership change, with chief financial officer Harish Abichandani stepping down and the board appointing Deepak Rastogi as his successor. Abichandani has resigned from the post with effect from the close of business on January 19, citing personal reasons. Rastogi, who has over three decades of experience across sectors, previously held senior finance leadership roles at companies such as Puravankara Group, Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals, and Tata AutoComp Systems, the filing showed. Rastogi has been appointed with effect from January 20.

news.body: Ola Electric announced that it has secured the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification and license for Ola in 6kW/9.1 kWh battery pack powered by 4680 Bharat Cell. Ola is the country's first residential BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) solution which is designed, engineered, and manufactured in India. The BIS license has been granted in conformance to IS 16242 (PART1): 2025/IEC 62040-1: 2017 standard tested by a BIS recognized testing laboratory.
